items.quote: Calculate the correlation coefficient between ApplicantIncome and LoanAmount.
items.description: 計算 ApplicantIncome 與 LoanAmount 的 Pearson 相關係數，忽略任一欄缺值的列，四捨五入到小數兩位，與 answer.txt 的 @correlation_coefficient 值比對。

items.quote: @correlation_coefficient[corr_coeff] where "corr_coeff" is a number between -1 and 1, rounded to two decimal places
items.description: answer.txt 必須含 @correlation_coefficient[...] 項目，值為介於 -1 與 1 之間、四捨五入到兩位的數字。
